args.query: query parquet files with DuckDB and return a Polars DataFrame

results.title: DuckDB over Polars DataFrames: replacement scans, parquet roundtrip, group-by parity
results.summary: Query Polars DataFrames directly with DuckDB, return .pl() results, round-trip through parquet in tmp_path, and check group-by aggregations against Polars native output.

results.title: Validating polars DataFrame rows with pydantic v2 TypeAdapter and collecting errors
results.summary: Validate each polars row against a strict pydantic v2 model with a shared TypeAdapter, collect per-row errors instead of failing the batch, and catch polars and pydantic gotchas such as nulls, NaN, numeric strings and extra columns.

results.title: Polars DataFrame validation with pandera, collecting all errors
results.summary: Validate Polars DataFrames with a pandera.polars DataFrameModel, collect every failing check with lazy validation, and test the schema offline with in-memory frames.

results.title: PyArrow Table to Parquet bytes roundtrip with schema and compression
results.summary: Serialize a PyArrow Table to Parquet bytes in memory and read it back, checking schema, nulls, timezone, metadata and compression codec.

results.title: Pandas pyarrow-backed dtypes with partitioned Parquet round trips
results.summary: Write and read partitioned Parquet with pyarrow, enforce a pa.schema on write, and keep nullable ints intact using dtype_backend=pyarrow, tested offline on tmp_path.

results.title: TanStack Query Core fetch and cache
results.summary: Drive async data fetching with @tanstack/query-core QueryClient, covering staleTime, cache hits and invalidateQueries without React offline.

results.title: fast-glob file discovery with picomatch filters
results.summary: Find files with fast-glob using ignore lists, dotfile and depth options, and filter paths with compiled picomatch matchers, all against a temp directory fixture.

results.title: jsonpath-plus nested store query
results.summary: Query a nested store JSON with jsonpath-plus using filters, recursive descent and wildcards, asserting matched values and paths with resultType value and path. Offline.

results.title: qs nested query strings
results.summary: Parse and stringify nested query strings with qs, covering nested objects, bracket/index/repeat/comma array formats, depth limits and a typed filter parser offline.

results.title: pandas DataFrame to formatted Excel report with openpyxl styles and roundtrip read
results.summary: Write a DataFrame to a styled .xlsx with openpyxl (header styles, number formats, widths, freeze panes, filters), then read it back with pandas and verify, fully offline.

data.hint: Call get_recipe with an id for the full files.
